sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 368 (per-loop search + campsitePaging.do, all 97 campsites and 10 cabins parsed)

values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead, same day included. Campsites need 2 nights, but a 1-night stay can be booked within 3 days of arrival. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away before registering again.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/lake-erie-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=368 (Booking Window: Campsite 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; 'Campsites are reservable for a 2 night minimum'; 'If you make your reservation within 3 days of your arrival you can book a 1-night stay'; LENGTH OF STAY 'maximum of 14 continuous nights ... must leave the site and facility for 48 hours'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The park says 81 electric sites 'ranging from 15 to 50 amps'; ReserveAmerica tags 79 of its 97 campsites 50-amp. Loop 085-097 is non-electric. No full hookups.

hookups.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/lake-erie-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=368 ('The campground offers 81 electric sites ranging from 15 to 50 amps'; 'Loop 085-097 is a non-electric loop') + ReserveAmerica site list ('Electric Hookup available: 50 amp' 79, 'Electric Hookup - no' 18, 'Full Hookup - no' 97), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The park counts 99 campsites; ReserveAmerica sells 97 in loops A, B, D and the non-electric N loop: 37 listed as 47-ft back-ins (mostly D), 36 at 37 ft (mostly A), 6 at 27 ft, 15 at 18 ft (mostly N). A towed boat may have to park in the gravel lot by the sites.

sites.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/lake-erie-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=368 ('the park's 99 campsites or 10 cabins'; 'Campsite (97)'; 'you may be required to park your boat in the gravel lot adjacent to the campsites') + ReserveAmerica site list ('47 Back-In' 37, '37 Back-In' 35, '37' 1, '42 Back-In' 1, '27 Back-In' 6, '18 Back-In' 15, no driveway 2), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/lake-erie-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=368 ('showers, picnic areas with grills, pavilions, a dump station'; Services and Amenities 'Water Fillup Station'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed on ReserveAmerica (parkId 368): reservable (state:NY row, now on the entry), 2027 season May 21 - Oct 10 (matches), 50-amp electric (matches the fee note). Added 9-month window, 2-night minimum waived within 3 days, 14-night max, 99 sites to 47 ft, showers, dump, water fill. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Note kept.
